job: Take the kitchen trash bag out to the bins at the kerb
understood_as: Pick up the tied kitchen trash bag and carry it out of the building to the bins at the kerb.
steps: Pick up the tied trash bag in the kitchen
Carry it out of the building

demos.why: Shows how the hand hooks and lifts the tied bag and carries it toward the way out.
Shows how firmly to hold the bag handle or knot so it does not slip or tear.

unmet: Putting the bag into the bins at the kerb: the planner can only carry it to the way out of the building, not to the bins outside.
